final:
pad2(n: int) -> str =
  pre n >= 0
  pre n < 100
  if n < 10
    return "0\(n)"
  "\(n)"

stamp(ts: int) -> str =
  post out.char_count() == 8
  ex stamp(0) == "00:00:00"
  ex stamp(59) == "00:00:59"
  ex stamp(3661) == "01:01:01"
  ex stamp(86399) == "23:59:59"
  ex stamp(86400) == "00:00:00"
  let s = ts % 86400
  let h = pad2(s // 3600)
  let m = pad2((s % 3600) // 60)
  let sec = pad2(s % 60)
  "\(h):\(m):\(sec)"

test_stamp() =
  assert stamp(0) == "00:00:00"
  assert stamp(3661) == "01:01:01"
  assert stamp(86399) == "23:59:59"
  assert stamp(90061) == "01:01:01"
